detail.title: Bang Plus FMUB 4.1 CH 78W Multimedia Speaker
detail.overview: Bang Plus FMUB 4.1 CH 78W Multimedia Speaker With superb sound quality, lies a 78W power output which is a 16 mm overall driver size. It has 5.1 connectivity of Bluetooth with a 10 metre range and the capability of being simply controlled by an IR remote. It even has a built-in FM and supports USB drives up to 32 GB. Strong Power Output 78W (30W + 12W x 4) You only need the 78W power output to give your home a superb audio experience. It makes a signal with the help of electricity, which is subsequently reproduced as a thudding noise. Fully Functional Remote Control Our IR Remote gives you well-built functionality and enables you to operate practically all of the features with a single tap. Our Speaker has a fantastic display to show off the specifics. USB/FM/BT/AUX Features a number of ports including AUX, BT, FM & USB. Ease of Recording The sound can be recorded with multiple slots available Bluetooth Connectivity with 10m range You can enjoy your music even from a distance, thanks to the Bluetooth V5.1 Connectivity that can connect in upto 10m range.
